review_improvement: Retains simple read-only coverage while preventing an unapproved binary or dangerous help-listed operation from being mistaken for a valid tool check.
independent_technical_reasoning: Version and help output validate different properties: version binds the build while help validates the installed interface. Both need exit status and complete stderr because a banner may print even on partial runtime failure. Since the package is explicitly external, command availability alone is not provenance. Help text can advertise destructive injection/reset functions, but reading it does not authorize their execution.
